verdict.rationale: Okta ships event hooks (outbound webhooks triggered by org events) and an MCP server that lets AI agents perform Okta operations via natural language, both of which support building automated, event-driven background processes; SCIM also automates user/group provisioning without human intervention. However, there's no evidence of a dedicated scheduling/workflow automation engine (e.g., Okta Workflows) or persistent autonomous agent execution loops in this pack. Missing for 10: evidence of a no-code/low-code automation builder, scheduled/recurring automation execution, and independent confirmation of agents running unattended over time.
